description: This file defines the FifoHandler class, which manages communication over POSIX system FIFOs (named pipes), including connection initiation, reading, writing, and cleanup.

classes.name: FifoHandler
classes.description: Handles communication over POSIX FIFO pipes, including connection setup, data transfer, and cleanup.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the FifoHandler with FIFO paths and timeout.

methods.name: initiate_connection
methods.description: Starts threads to open FIFO pipes and monitor connection timeout.

methods.name: _make_fifo_file
methods.description: Creates FIFO file if it does not exist.

methods.name: _open_fifo
methods.description: Opens FIFO pipes for reading and writing.

methods.name: _opening_monitor
methods.description: Monitors FIFO opening process and enforces timeout.

methods.name: _unblock_open_fifo_operation
methods.description: Workaround to unblock FIFO opening by imitating the other side.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Closes FIFO pipes, stops threads, and cleans up FIFO files.

methods.name: is_open
methods.description: Checks if FIFO connection is open.
